## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 481 captures during May 2022. This represents the activity completed at the site during the month. The recorded volume provides the basis for the subsequent image-quality and grading review.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 6 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.2 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and the result should be considered alongside the overall activity reported for May 2022.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 96 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 23 days. This is the median interval recorded for the period and provides an indication of the time between image capture and completion of grading.

Overall, the site completed 481 captures in May 2022, with a 1.2 per cent ungradable rate and 96 referable results.
